notes.title: Gallery Update!
notes.notes:
One of the complaints I've noticed so far has been something silly I missed. I never thought about a [b]gallery[/b] before! I put a basic one together now that is honestly a bit too available. Never-the-less, I wanted to get it out there. I intend on adjusting it a little more in time, but for now there is at least this. 

From the level selection, I have included an enterable scene that lets you view all the ladies. No puzzle needed! Just click the gallery icon with the text saying "NEW!" beside it, and you'll be lead there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271569/834d63f9c42a4aac404b9ccfc33743e48aac358e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271569/c34055efe3bd5d3707feef759fc5254ec1d756b0.jpg[/img]

Then you can just select one of them and view to your enjoyment! It's pretty basic, but hopefully can hold over until I build a proper way to do this (such as linking it to your achievement progress).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271569/55f5d94514bd23c985494c5a701b1d6615ce7386.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SAPG Launches This Friday!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44271569/a4973f07223ba5c561c7c9ebbd5cbd1f3b8337bc.png[/img]

I'm extremely excited to get this out there, hopefully you guys enjoy this small little block jigsaw puzzle game of mine! Be sure to [b]wishlist[/b] it as it always helps. 

The finished build of "Sexy Anime Puzzle Game" is pushed live and is ready for launch day. With the first version of this game launching, I do intend on adding more content as time goes on, much like what I did with my first title. Hope you like what I've made! :)

[b]Just three days away now, hype![/b]
